# Managed offline analysis components

- Ruff 0.17.5 — https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff — MIT, Copyright Charles Marsh.
- ty 0.0.104 — https://github.com/astral-sh/ty — MIT, Copyright Astral Software Inc.

Official PyPI wheels are kept intact, including their dist-info/licenses files and third-party notices. manifest.json records each original URL and SHA-256 digest. The app verifies the digest before first extraction. Bundled targets: macOS arm64/x86_64 and Windows x86_64. These are static analysis/formatting tools, separate from the learner's Python runtime. No download is required when using them.
